MERN STACK – Better Tomorrow 2025 
Developed ElectroMart, a full-stack e-commerce web application built using the MERN stack. The project involved 
architecting a RESTful API to handle core business logic, including comprehensive CRUD operations for products, 
users, shopping carts, and order processing . By designing a scalable database schema using MongoDB and 
Mongoose, the system ensures efficient data retrieval and storage for diverse product categories. 
Tech Stacks :- React JS , Node JS , Express JS , MongoDB 
 
PROJECTS 
STUDY SYNC – Real-Time Collaborative Study Platform 2026 
Developed a full-stack web application using Spring Boot and React JS . Used WebSockets (STOMP) to facilitate 
real-time peer-to-peer learning through synchronized virtual study rooms. Engineered a high-concurrency backend to 
manage live messaging and interactive user sessions, ensuring seamless data flow with a modern, responsive UI. 
Leveraged Maven for dependency management and followed MVC architecture to build a scalable and maintainable 
collaborative environment. 
 
INTELLIFARM – AI Powered Smart Agriculture Platform: 2025 
Developed a Flutter-based mobile application to connect farmers, dealers, and drivers through a unified platform. 
Implemented features like real -time weather updates, soil moisture monitoring, and government scheme information 
for farmers. Enabled dealers to manage products, communicate with farmers, and coordinate transport requests, 
enhancing overall agricultural efficiency. 
 
AIR QUALITY PREDICTION & FORECASTING 2025 
Built a Python-based machine learning application to analyze environmental data and predict future air quality. Cleaned 
and prepared raw datasets, trained predictive models, and tested their accuracy to forecast pollution levels. Designed 
the system to pro vide clear, data-driven insights, making it easier to track and anticipate changes in the environment 
and monitor overall air health.
